title: Qualify a sales opportunity
summary: When a prospect may become a commercial opportunity. An evidence-based qualification and next-step decision with an owner and recorded customer commitments.
outcomes: An evidence-based qualification and next-step decision with an owner and recorded customer commitments.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a prospect may become a commercial opportunity.

parts.title: Prepare the account and problem brief
parts.guidance: Collect the prospect's stated problem, organization, existing solution and prior interactions from authorized records. Separate verified customer statements from assumptions and avoid adding unnecessary personal information.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Confirm the need and buying process
parts.guidance: Discuss the desired outcome, decision participants, constraints and purchasing process with the prospect. Record unanswered questions and distinguish a user's interest from authority or budget to buy.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Confirm the need and buying process

parts.title: Assess fit and delivery dependencies
parts.guidance: Compare the requested outcome with actual product capability, security needs, support and implementation effort. Flag roadmap promises, regulated uses or custom work that need separate approval.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Choose the next commercial step
parts.guidance: The sales owner decides whether to proceed, nurture, refer or decline. Agree the next customer action and any approved discovery, demonstration or pilot without inventing a close date.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Update the pipeline evidence
parts.guidance: Record the stage, reasoning, value assumptions, owner and next review. Keep proposals and contract commitments in their reviewed processes and close stale opportunities with an explicit reason.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An evidence-based qualification and next-step decision with an owner and recorded customer commitments.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting.
